extractions.notes: The Bucket List Family (@thebucketlistfamily, Garrett and Jessica Gee) do not publish free day-by-day itineraries on Instagram; their country pages on thebucketlistfamily.com are trip journals with named stops and recommendations. Their 50 structured itineraries exist only inside the paid National Geographic book 'Bucket List Family Travel' (Jessica Gee, ISBN 9781426222238), which could not be extracted for free. Recorded 1 trip-journal itinerary (Hawaii) + 1 recommendation-list trip (Utah Valley) at medium confidence.

items.details: Stated as the accommodation for the 3-day trip (Haleiwa). Booked via Airbnb.
items.name: Kai Nalu House

items.details: Underwater photography course taken with the family during the stay.
items.name: Underwater photography course with Jake Marote

items.details: The family noted 'Love the North Shore' as a favorite area from the trip.
items.name: North Shore

itineraries.summary: A 3-day family stop on Oahu (September 2015 journal entry). The family stayed at the Kai Nalu House in Haleiwa, took an underwater photography course with Jake Marote, and Garrett spoke to a youth soccer team. Not day-by-day, but a genuine trip record with dates, accommodation and named activities.
itineraries.title: Hawaii family stop (Oahu)
Utah Valley Adventures
itineraries.summary: A family recommendation list tied to their Utah Valley trip (their hometown, explored over a few days with Explore Utah Valley): Sundance chairlift, Fifth Water Hot Springs hike, SUP at Payson Lakes, Rowley's Red Barn, Thanksgiving Point's Holdman Studios/Farm Country/Light of the World Garden, and dinner at Aubergine restaurant. Not day-by-day, but genuine named stops from their own trip journal.

items.name: Sundance
items.details: Took the chairlift to the top and cruised around; kids loved the chairlift; hikes and trails in summer, skiing in winter.

items.name: Fifth Water Hot Springs hike
items.details: Great family hike up Diamond Fork Canyon ending at sulphur-y hot pots; about a 3-hour round trip.

items.name: Stand-up paddle boarding at Payson Lakes
items.details: With Epic Recreation; a huge family-sized paddle board.

items.name: Rowley's Red Barn
items.details: Family business with hay rides, fruit picking (apples, peaches, cherries), fresh produce store; try the fresh apple juice and apple slushy float.

items.name: Holdman Studios
items.details: Glass blowing and stained-glass art studio of Tom Holdman.

items.name: Farm Country
items.details: Family farm experience; kids ride ponies and see cows, rabbits, horses, turkeys, goats and baby chicks.

items.name: The Light of the World Garden
items.details: Peaceful garden with fifteen pieces depicting parables and miracles of Christ.

items.name: Aubergine restaurant
items.details: Welcoming owners the family called out as a highlight.

extractions.notes: @thecommonwanderer (Mark and Mim) run thecommonwanderer.com, one of the richest itinerary sources in the batch. Extracted 2 itineraries: the 7-day Faroe Islands road trip (opened full page, high confidence) and the 2-day Great Ocean Road trip (from their own day-by-day guide page content, medium confidence as only day 1 detail was captured). They have many more itineraries (Lake Balaton 3-day, Hoi An 3-day, Poon Hill trek, etc.) that a follow-up pass could extract.

items.details: Rented for the full road trip; handled everything fine. Weekly hire upwards of £400/€500 in high season.
items.name: Toyota Yaris rental car

items.details: Village near the airport with grass roofs and sea-stacks of Dragarnir and Tindholur.
items.name: Bour village

items.details: Waterfall cascading straight into the North Atlantic; essential stop.
items.name: Mulafossur Waterfall

items.details: Overnight stay recommended in Gasadalur for sunset, hikes and sunrise over the falls.
items.name: Gasadalsgardurin Guesthouse

items.details: Dinner spot serving fresh smoked salmon.
items.name: Cafe Fjorooy

items.details: Ferry from Sorvagur (15-min drive from Gasadalur); book tickets in advance, weather permitting.
items.name: Mykines ferry

items.details: Visit the puffin colony and hike to the island lighthouse.
items.name: Mykines Island puffins and lighthouse

items.details: Kayak the North Atlantic, then afternoon hiking on the island.
items.name: North Atlantic kayaking + Kalsoy hiking

items.details: Lighthouse on a 700m sheer drop; must-visit on the Faroes.

items.details: Quirky, colourful island with an artsy community; day trip across the harbour from Torshavn. Check out the lighthouse, Nolywood sign and artwork.

items.details: Afternoon in the capital; old town Tinganes dates to the 1400s.

items.details: Largest lake in the Faroes with the optical illusion of hanging over the sea; nearby 142m Trælanipa cliff.

items.details: Faroes' only Michelin-starred restaurant, modern Faroese cuisine; 12-course meal described as once-in-a-lifetime.
items.name: KOKS

items.details: Village in a natural amphitheatre with tidal lagoon, hiking paths, viewpoints and waterfalls.

items.details: Waterfall and coastal village on Streymoy.

items.details: Village on Eysturoy explored on the final full day.

itineraries.summary: A detailed 7-day DIY road trip around the Faroe Islands based on the couple's own 2018 trip: Vagar (Mulafossur, Bour) on day 1, a puffin day trip to Mykines on day 2, kayaking and Kalsoy's lighthouse on day 3, Nolsoy and Torshavn on day 4, Vagar plus Michelin-starred KOKS on day 5, Streymoy (Saksun, Fossa, Tjornuvik) on day 6, and Eysturoy (Gjógv, Funningur) on day 7, with two Torshavn hotels named.
itineraries.title: 7-Day Faroe Islands Road Trip Itinerary

items.details: Depart Melbourne early via the M1/Princess Freeway toward Geelong, then the B100 onto the Great Ocean Road.
items.name: Drive Melbourne to the Great Ocean Road

items.details: Recommended brunch/coffee stop on Torquay's esplanade; avo toast with chipotle hummus, goats cheese and smoked almonds recommended.
items.name: Pond Cafe

items.details: Detour to the famous surf waves where the Rip Curl Pro is held.
items.name: Bells Beach

items.details: Photo stop at the memorial arch, Split Point lighthouse for coastal views, Fairhaven beach for a swim, and the Aireys Inlet pub for lunch.
items.name: Great Ocean Road sights: memorial arch, Split Point lighthouse, Fairhaven beach, Aireys Inlet pub

items.details: Stunning 30m falls ~10 min drive from Lorne; cooler than anywhere else in the area.
items.name: Erskine Falls

itineraries.summary: The couple's two-day Great Ocean Road itinerary: day 1 runs Melbourne to Lorne via Torquay (Pond Cafe brunch), Bells Beach, the memorial arch, Split Point lighthouse, Fairhaven beach, the Aireys Inlet pub and Erskine Falls. Published as a tried-and-tested route; only day-1 detail was captured in the source read, so confidence is medium.
itineraries.title: 2-Day Great Ocean Road Itinerary

extractions.notes: @theplanetd (Dave and Deb) run theplanetd.com with a dedicated Travel Itineraries section (tried-and-tested sample itineraries worldwide). Extracted 2: 3-day Istanbul (opened full page, high confidence) and 3-day Seoul (day-by-day overview from their own guide page, high confidence as the day plan comes from their guide). Many more exist (Taiwan 7-day, Bangkok 3-day, Edinburgh 3-day, Lisbon 48h, etc.).

items.details: Start with a traditional Turkish breakfast (kahvalti): cured meats, dips, cheeses, egg, breads, pastries, honey and jams.
items.name: Traditional Turkish breakfast (kahvalti)

items.details: Oldest building in Istanbul (537 AD); free access with museum pass or 72TL at entrance. Tram stop Sultanahmet.
items.name: Hagia Sophia

items.details: Sultan Ahmet Mosque with its blue ceramic tile interior; built by Sultan Ahmed I.
items.name: Blue Mosque

items.details: Park connecting the two mosques; see the Obelisk of Theodosius and Ottoman fountains. Try dondurma (Turkish ice cream) here.
items.name: Sultanahmet Square

items.details: Underground reservoir built 532 AD by Emperor Justinian; 336 columns. Cost 72 TL.
items.name: Basilica Cistern

items.details: Ottoman sultans' palace/museum with Harem; famous tiling and treasury exhibits.
items.name: Topkapi Palace

items.details: Evening cruise from the Golden Horn covering the Bosphorus Strait between Europe and Asia; they recommend a 2.5-hour luxury dinner cruise with Turkish food (meze, raki) and Whirling Dervishes.
items.name: Sunset Bosphorus dinner cruise

items.details: One of the oldest and largest covered markets in the world: 61 streets, 4000+ shops; try a Turkish rug, lantern or nazar amulet, and relax in a tea shop with çay.
items.name: Grand Bazaar

items.details: 17th-century L-shaped market overwhelmed by the smell of spices; great place to buy Turkish tea.
items.name: Spice Bazaar

items.details: Their favorite restaurant in Eminonu for lamb sis kebap that melts in the mouth; affordable local flavors.
items.name: Sehzade Cag Kebap

items.details: Walk across the 490m Galata Bridge over the Golden Horn, lined with local fishermen.
items.name: Galata Bridge

items.details: Most famous attraction in modern Istanbul, in the Beyoglu district; built 1348.
items.name: Galata Tower

items.details: Evening on the modern city's famous shopping and nightlife street with Taksim Square.
items.name: Istiklal Street and Taksim

items.details: Morning Turkish bath on the final day.
items.name: Turkish bath (Hammam)

items.details: Food and cafe district on the Asian side.
items.name: Kadikoy

items.details: Mosque with Maiden's Tower area views in Uskudar.
items.name: Camlica Mosque and Uskudar

items.details: 7-day card with skip-the-line tickets to top attractions, 10 public transport rides, and vouchers for Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace and the Bosphorus cruise.
items.name: Istanbul Card

itineraries.summary: The perfect 3 days in Istanbul: day 1 covers Sultanahmet's historic core (Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Sultanahmet Square, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace) ending with a sunset Bosphorus dinner cruise; day 2 is the Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, lunch at Sehzade Cag Kebap in Eminonu, Galata Bridge, Galata Tower and Istiklal Street; day 3 is a hammam plus Kadikoy, Camlica Mosque and Uskudar on the Asian side. Co-written with The Turkey Traveler.
itineraries.title: 3 Days in Istanbul Itinerary

items.details: Palace, hanok village and shopping street: the historic sightseeing day.
items.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village, Insadong

items.details: Hike Inwangsan Peak, food at Gwangjang Market, evening in Myeongdong up to N-Seoul Tower.
items.name: Inwangsan Peak, Gwangjang Market, Myeongdong, N-Seoul Tower

items.details: Palace, design plaza, Gangnam district and Common Ground.
items.name: Changdeokgung, Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Gangnam, Common Ground

items.details: Walking-heavy itinerary; Seoul's public transport is excellent and the post covers which transit cards to buy.
items.name: Seoul transit cards

itineraries.summary: A 3-day Seoul itinerary blending must-do sightseeing with casual wandering and unmissable food stops: day 1 is Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village and Insadong; day 2 is Inwangsan Peak, Gwangjang Market, Myeongdong and N-Seoul Tower; day 3 is Changdeokgung, Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Gangnam and Common Ground. The guide includes a saveable itinerary map and transit-card tips.
itineraries.title: The Ultimate Seoul Itinerary - 3 Days in Seoul

extractions.notes: @theslowtraveler (Carolyn, theslowtraveler.net) publishes full personal trip reports with day-by-day itineraries. Extracted 2: the 9-day Airlie Beach to Port Douglas road trip (opened full page, high confidence) and the 3-day Great Ocean Road trip (from her own guide page content, medium confidence as only day-1 detail was captured). She has more (Hamilton Island 4-night, Port Douglas Barrier Reef/Daintree, Tongariro circuit) for follow-up.

itineraries.destination: North Queensland (Airlie Beach to Port Douglas)

items.details: Lengthy ferry and bus transfer from Hamilton Island to Proserpine Airport to pick up the rental car.
items.name: Ferry and bus to Proserpine Airport

items.details: Chosen because they were the only provider with unlimited miles; upgraded to a much larger vehicle at no extra charge.
items.name: Europcar rental

items.details: About $80/night; cheap stopover. She would NOT recommend it (AC barely worked, grimy floors); The Robert Towns in Townsville was much nicer.
items.name: Hotel Allen

items.details: First sightseeing stop; clean clear creek for a swim, peaceful, had it to themselves.
items.name: Crystal Creek

items.details: Spa Pool, Dead Horse Creek and Attie Creek Falls (highlight of the day, best waterfall of the trip); Cardwell Lookout views of Hinchinbrook Island.
items.name: Cardwell State Forest waterfalls

items.details: Three-way junction of waterways, great for swimming in the day but cut short by mosquitoes at twilight.
items.name: Alligators Nest

items.details: Another cheap motel stopover for the night.
items.name: Cheap motel in Innisfail

items.details: Multiple tiers and viewing platforms; brute force of water; highlight of the road trip so far.
items.name: Josephine Falls

items.details: Large sandy swimming area at a three-way water junction plus boulder rapids downstream.
items.name: Babinda Boulders

items.details: Skipped as costly after seeing a lot of forest already.
items.name: Skyrail Rainforest Cableway (skipped)

items.details: Extravagant five-star stay; lagoon-style pools surrounding each hotel block, golf course at entrance. Dinner at one of the hotel restaurants was not recommended for the price.
items.name: Sheraton Mirage Port Douglas

items.details: One of their most awaited activities: crocodile cruise.
items.name: Daintree crocodile cruise

items.details: Horse riding on the beach near Cape Tribulation.
items.name: Beach horse riding

items.details: Drove as far as the lookout at Cape Tribulation Beach via multiple boardwalk hikes; ancient rainforest with tall trees and twisting vines.
items.name: Daintree boardwalk hikes

items.details: Designated lazy day: slept in, cocktails and beers by the giant lagoon pool all day.
items.name: Sheraton Mirage lagoon pool day

items.details: Slow walk on Four Mile Beach on day 3/5 rest time.
items.name: Four Mile Beach walk

items.details: Introductory scuba dive and snorkeling boat trip (three reef stops: Coronation Corner, Barracuda Bommie, Castle Rock). Reef quality 'on another level' vs Hamilton Island.
items.name: Barrier Reef scuba and snorkel boat trip

items.details: Drive north from Port Douglas to explore the Tablelands; the author found it underwhelming vs alternatives.
items.name: Atherton Tablelands

items.details: Squeezed in after the Atherton Tablelands underdelivered; then back to Townsville for the night.
items.name: Magnetic Island

items.details: Drive south back to the airport to end the loop.
items.name: Return drive to Proserpine Airport

itineraries.summary: Carolyn and Anh's own 9-day North Queensland loop: day 1 transfer from Hamilton Island to Proserpine Airport, Europcar rental and cheap stop at Townsville's Hotel Allen; day 2 waterfalls (Crystal Creek, Cardwell State Forest, Alligators Nest) to Innisfail; day 3 Josephine Falls and Babinda Boulders, then the Sheraton Mirage Port Douglas; day 4 Daintree (croc cruise, beach horse riding, boardwalks); day 5 lazy lagoon-pool day; day 6 Great Barrier Reef scuba/snorkel; days 7-8 Atherton Tablelands and Magnetic Island; day 9 back to Proserpine.
itineraries.title: Airlie Beach to Port Douglas Road Trip: 9-Day Itinerary

items.details: 90-minute drive from Melbourne south-west to the coast.
items.name: Drive Melbourne to Aireys Inlet

items.details: Hosts the Bells Beach Pro surf event; viewing platforms with miles of coastline; peaceful at sunset.
items.name: Bells Beach

items.details: Afternoon coffee and gelato stop; decent ice cream, visually impressive treats.
items.name: Great Ocean Road Chocolaterie and Ice Creamery

items.details: Small roadside lookout on shipwreck history; probably not worth the stop unless that's your thing.
items.name: Anglesea Lookout

items.details: Booked a last-minute affordable room (low season); in summer booking ahead is recommended.
items.name: Hotel in Aireys Inlet (unnamed)

itineraries.summary: Carolyn's 3-day Great Ocean Road road trip: day 1 covers Melbourne to Aireys Inlet via Bells Beach, the Great Ocean Road Chocolaterie and Ice Creamery, and the Anglesea Lookout, with an overnight stay in Aireys Inlet. Published on her own guide with a video version; only day-1 detail was captured in the source read, so confidence is medium.
itineraries.title: Epic 3-Day Road Trip along the Great Ocean Road

extractions.notes: @thesolosociety (The Solo Society, ~145K followers) is a solo-travel COMMUNITY account focused on group travel content, community inspiration, events and safety guidance — not personal trip itineraries. Web and social searches found no day-by-day itineraries, travel guides, hotel/activity recommendations tied to a trip, or linked blog with itineraries. Per the honesty rules, no itinerary was forced. If itinerary content exists, it is not publicly extractable.
